SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Communicatio n in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do communication networks influence the development of a country?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify modes of communication in Eastern Africa
2. explain challenges facing communication networks in Eastern Africa
3. state possible solutions to challenges facing communication networks in Eastern Africa
4. demonstrate how different modes of communication are used in Eastern Africa
5. appreciate the role of communication networks in Eastern Africa
